items.title: The Brooklyn Nets and Grant Nelson have agreed to a two-way deal, agent Max Wiepking of Gersh Basketball told @hoopshypeofficial.bsky.social. The 24-year-old, 7-footer impressed on a 10-day NBA contract at the end of last season.
